newsitem.title: USA: Donnelley Enterprise to service law firm.
newsitem.headline: Donnelley Enterprise to service law firm.

text.p: Donnelley Enterprise Solutions Inc said Wednesday it entered into a substantial, three-year contract with the law firm Sidley & Austin to provide it with custom outsourcing services for its information technology operations.
The value of the agreement was not disclosed.

Terms provide for Donnelley Enterprise to have more than 30 professionals on site providing a variety of support services, including custom desktop support and technology support for the firm's Los Angeles office as well as fax server management companywide.
Donnelley Enterprise provides information technology and outsourcing services.
